# SwillFam

> SwillFam is a Jakarta hospitality group running lifestyle and nightlife venues across South Jakarta — a restaurant and bar, a café, cocktail bars and clubs in SCBD, Senopati and Ashta District 8. Its venues are Kilo Jakarta, Kilo Cafe, Dualism, Truce, Zoo, Le Cirque and Swillhouse.

Key facts:
- Head office: Fairgrounds, SCBD Lot 14, Jl. Jenderal Sudirman, Senayan, Kebayoran Baru, Jakarta Selatan 12190
- Reservations and private-event enquiries: WhatsApp [REAL NUMBER] — each venue page also lists its own reservation WhatsApp
- Email: contact@swillfam.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/swillfam
